name: nested-handle-inside-handle-valid
description: a valid handle step nested two levels deep inside another handle's branch `do`, proving the schema's full-depth recursion does not reject a runtime-valid script.
yaml:
appId: com.example.app
name: Nested handle
env: {}
---
- launchApp
- handle:
    - when: { visible: "Outer" }
      do:
        - handle:
            - when: { visible: "Inner" }
              do:
                - tap: "Confirm"
            - otherwise: skip
    - otherwise: fail
